svg.title: Jobs reachable within 30 minutes, walking and by public transport
svg.desc: Two maps of Porto Alegre covered by a grid of hexagons, coloured by the number of jobs reachable within 30 minutes from each cell. Walking, the cells of the city centre reach 50 to 100 thousand and the south of the grid fewer than 10 thousand. With public transport, the centre and the corridors leading to it reach more than 100 thousand, and most of the grid more than 25 thousand.
